newsitem.title: USA: Viacom stake held by Gabelli group.
newsitem.headline: Viacom stake held by Gabelli group.

text.p: A group led by New York investment manager Mario Gabelli said Tuesday it holds a 5.06 percent stake in Viacom Inc or 3,518,109 Class A common shares.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions included a net 786,843 Class A common purchased between December 9, 1996 and February 13 at prices ranging from $31.5044 to $36.8750 per share.
The group holds the stake for investment purposes.

Viacom, based in New York, is engaged in television program and feature film distribution for television exhibition in domestic and international markets, television production and advertising service operations.
